mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS itemId, i.name AS itemName, i.sales_unit AS salesUnit, COALESCE(MAX(s.min_stock), 0) AS minStock, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity FROM items i LEFT JOIN item_stocks s ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.is_active = 1 GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.sales_unit ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) < COALESCE(MAX(s.min_stock), 0)) DESC, i.name ASC
SELECT * FROM item_stocks WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND lot_number = #{lotNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_stocks (item_id, lot_number, quantity, production_date) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{lotNumber}, #{quantity}, #{productionDate})
